name: Güneş ve Ay
scene: A golden sun with a simple face shines above a crescent moon and three stars inside a round arch.
notes: Second generation selected: face is now three closed coloured panes. Visually inspected. Remaining doubts: some ray/star/moon tips still coincide with background seams, several sky joins remain four-way, the top ray approaches the rim too closely, and a few wavy rays are narrow. Flat fills retain slight tonal variation. Preserve circular sun and crescent contours; relocate background seams and verify 70–130 panes when tracing. Final raster estimate: 94 coloured components, within 70–130; count is approximate and does not certify topology.

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Produce one flat vector-like DESIGN SHEET for a Cartograph four-colour stained-glass puzzle, NOT finished glass artwork.
Portrait 3:4 canvas, ideally 1536x2048. Panel centered and nearly touching all canvas edges, plain pure #FFFFFF exterior only. Thick closed black outer lead silhouette. No inset frame, no surrounding photo context.
EXACTLY FOUR specified flat solid fill colours inside panel. Black #000000 is exclusively uniform lead, no black filled details; white only outside panel. No pale cream, no white glass. No texture, gradients, translucency, shading, highlights, text, signatures or dots.
Pure black smooth uniform lead lines about 1% canvas width everywhere (15 px at 1536). 80-100 CLOSED panes, 70-130 allowed. Each meaningful subject piece or background band is an individual closed fill area. Every separator reaches another separator or rim, NO free line ends. ONLY THREE-WAY/T JUNCTIONS: no X, no 4+ panes at a point; stagger neighboring junctions at least 3% of panel width apart. Background dividers must stop at subject contours at separated locations, never distort the subject. Pane widths >=3% panel width except their own pointed tips; pane areas >=1/1000 panel area. No nearly parallel narrow slivers, tiny chips, near-touches or hairline necks. Angles >=30 degrees. Eyes are sufficiently large closed round panes. Use broad organic sky/water/leaf/feather subdivisions, never an arbitrary grid. Choose different palette fills on adjacent panes when possible.
The supplied photograph is a SUBJECT AND MOOD REFERENCE, not an edit target; draw a fresh composition with its recognizable subject and natural types of background subdivision. Remove photographed setting, decorative frames, glass effects, fine details that cannot become closed panes.
PANEL: ROUND ARCH, semicircle top, long straight sides and flat bottom. SUBJECT: a large golden sun in the upper half, a broad golden crescent moon in lower-left half, three well-spaced large four-point stars on the right and between them, against deep blue celestial sky, inspired by the reference photo. Redraw simplified celestial scene. Sun has a perfectly round main disc with simple calm face made from just two closed broad curved eye panes and one closed broad nose/mouth shape; no dangling lines. Around disc use 12 broad alternating straight and gently wavy rays. Rays attach at widely spaced points around circular disc; never crowd many into one point. No narrow double ring around sun. Crescent spans about half panel width and is subdivided into 5 broad closed pieces; keep clean moon contour and generous inner blue area. Stars are each ONE large four-point closed pane, no internal crosses, each at least 9% panel width, no tiny stars. Background subdivided into 50-60 broad sweeping celestial sky panes with staggered T junctions, not a grid. Overall 80-100 panes. EXACT four flat colours: sun gold #E8BD45, amber orange #D88832, night blue #244D7A, sky teal #4A92A1. White ONLY outside. No texture, no glitter, no gradients, no extra hues; solid vector bucket fills.
CORRECTION: Sun face MUST consist of three SEPARATE CLOSED COLOURED SHAPES inside disc: two broad amber oval eyes and a simple amber oval smiling mouth. No eyebrows, nose, eyelashes, open strokes or thin black linework. Same 1%-canvas lead width on face as rest. Shorten ALL sun rays so outer tips stay at least 5% canvas width from panel rim and from moon, and at least 5% from any background junction. Ray tips must point into a SINGLE broad blue pane: no background divider can meet a ray tip. Similarly NO background seams meet star tips or moon tips; terminate background seams on broad sides of motifs, spaced well apart. Star interiors are each one closed gold pane, broad center. Keep 80-100 panes by dividing spacious blue areas using separated T junctions. Uniform flat exact palette, no gradients.

rasterReview.method: 4-connected components of saturated coloured pixels (max-min >35, max >80), components >=100 pixels; approximate raster check, not vector geometry audit
rasterReview.reason: Remaining junction/width issues and slight fill variation documented in notes.

subjectMask.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached FINISHED design sheet into a binary subject segmentation mask. Preserve the exact portrait 3:4 canvas, same size, framing, panel silhouette and every subject contour/pane position. Do not redraw, resize, move, add or remove objects. Fill every subject pane PURE BLACK #000000, regardless of original colour. Fill every background pane PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Exterior stays pure white. All existing black lead lines can remain black; internal subject seams disappear into black fill (do NOT turn seams white). No grey, colour, shading, gradients, textures, text or legend. This is a semantic pane-majority mask: classify actual object membership, NOT merely the original fill colour. SUBJECT BLACK: ONLY the large circular sun disc including both eyes and mouth (solid completely black circle), the entire crescent moon including all its yellow pieces, and all three four-point stars. BACKGROUND WHITE: all straight and wavy rays around sun (the brief classifies rays as background), all blue/teal sky panes, the moon inner opening, exterior. Keep every existing black outline in position. Sun disc black, sun rays WHITE. No white eye or mouth holes within sun disc.
subjectMask.alignment: Approximate generated edit; intended for per-pane majority vote. Fine internal seam inversions and small contour differences may remain.
